title: Is paying $39 worth for an AI app that creates trading strategies for you based on your idea?
author: csinye
selftext: I have developed bots in the past. The development mostly used to be tricky and time taken to develop and backtest a complex bot was around 3-4 days, Do you think such an app is worth spending $39 on? Or will it actually deliver what it promises? It creates strategies using my input using AI, backtest it and I can literally download the working EA.
